trickyParts: The new root AGENTS.md bullet is itself inside acceptance 1's '*AGENTS.md' pathspec, so it states the identifier carve-out abstractly and spells no example name; any later edit that adds a worked example there would break the headline acceptance command.

The reference's ruling paragraph had to grow from three lines to four: the sentence holds 302 characters after the substitution, which does not fit three lines at the repository's 100-column hand wrap. That moves 'A ruling triggers the full reconciliation pass …' from line 39 to 40; the spec's acceptance only requires the grep to find it.
packages/envoy/AGENTS.md's replacement was kept to two lines on purpose, so the spec's pinned dependency-version lines stay at 529 and 605.

bun scripts/build.ts deletes and rewrites packages/claude-envoy/dist/ as well as legion/; the diff was checked to confirm dist/ and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES are untouched, which they are on this Bun 1.3.14 install.
deviations: One departure from the spec's wording, recorded by the planner and carried out as planned: the root AGENTS.md bullet states the Dispatch carve-out as skills/dispatch/SKILL.md line 55 actually reads — a decision carries the name of the person who made it when the agent was given one, and 'the person' when it was not — rather than the spec's unconditional phrasing. The spec's Summary, Acceptance and scope are unaffected.
No check script ships, by the human's answered decision on the spec ('Drop the check', 2026-10-24). A reviewer catches the next slip.
openQuestions: packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:280 now reads 'the operator's decision, LEGION-496' because the approved spec says so in as many words; if the architect reads that decision as the human's rather than the operator's, it is a one-word change.

This change does not reach the running controller: pods load the released @sjawhar/pi-legion (10.19.8 today) and a role prompt compiled into the deployed daemon binary, so the production check after the merge re-reads /opt/legion/pi-legion/dist/skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md in a pod and reports pending until a plugin released after the merge is installed.
discoveredComplexity: No simplify pass: the diff is documentation and prompt text only, so skill://ce-simplify-code and the thermonuclear pair do not apply and the PR body omits the Thermo line.

The name remains, by design and by the spec's scope, in docs/, deploy/, the Go and TypeScript sources, the scripts, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .omp-pin and the package changelogs (packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md keeps the LEGION-496 attribution that packages/envoy/AGENTS.md drops).
